11–21 July 2026 · Online

Global and local impact, built by students.

TechCommons hosted an online community-focused hackathon for students aged 13–17, encouraging participants to create technology addressing problems in their communities or around the world.

The brief

Participants worked under the theme Global & Local Impact. The challenge invited technology projects connected to problems around them, while leaving room for different project types and approaches.

What the event demonstrates

Project participation

Students moved from an open brief to public submissions within a defined online event window.

Range of ideas

Seventy submitted projects created a public record of varied problem choices and technical approaches.

Independent work

Participant projects belong to their creators. TechCommons does not republish project media or long descriptions without permission.

A base for future activity

The format gives schools and supporters concrete evidence when discussing workshops, project days or future challenges.

Public project information

For rules, projects, prizes and judging details, use the official event page rather than a copied version on this site.
